description: substack: Post. GET /v1/substack/post. One public post by publication and slug. Costs 1 credit when it succeeds. Errors, blocked or timed-out requests, invalid requests and cache hits cost nothing. A not-found or empty result is charged only where that operation's published cost says so.

cache_max_age.description: Serve a cached response when it is newer than this. A cache hit costs 0 credits.
